integrity_statement: This package presents a self-contained analytic proof with a finite exact-arithmetic combinatorial verification and supplementary sampling. It claims neither independent validation nor exhaustive historical priority.
limitations: Exact for Haar-uniform central planes of one regular truncated tetrahedron only; random affine offsets and deformed solids not addressed.
Voss (1982) treats frequencies of polygon counts under a different random-plane sampling convention; full source unavailable, so independent historical priority is unresolved.
title: Exact polygon-count law for random central sections of the regular truncated tetrahedron
